item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 6:00 PM, 11 September 2026(Friday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Nueva Ecija (Carranglan, Lupao, Cuyapo, and Talugtug), Tarlac (San Clemente, Camiling, Moncada, San Manuel, and Mayantoc), and Zambales (Masinloc) within the next 2 hours.

The above condition is affecting Zambales (Santa Cruz and Candelaria) which may persist within 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
